boundaries: The allocation is an execution wall-limit envelope charged once at reserve, not measured CPU seconds. Settlement releases capacity only; no unused wall refund even for known NOT_STARTED.
Reservation wall is rounded up to nanoseconds; total declared budget down to nanoseconds. Values are decimal integer text, not SQLite fixed-width debit arithmetic.
No age, PID, restart, stale-owner adoption or automatic uncertain reservation release exists.
Storage uncertainty keeps an in-process HOLD and attempts a durable Stop. It does not claim successful persistence if the database itself is unavailable.

Budget metadata is bounded to 16KiB per canonical value. Native terminal validation uses the existing attempt metadata bounds. This slice does not bound total reservation/decision history or claim constant-time history scans.
Same supplied main SQLite DB, physical DB/results identities and exact declaration are pinned. No second DB or JSONL ledger is introduced.
Tests use temporary storage only. Related native tests launch synthetic CPU children only and clean captured supervision handles. No GPU/provider, holdout plaintext, host process scan or host kill.
